transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello! I'm Dora, a clinical conversational agent. I conducted your post-cataract surgery follow-up check. Do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. When can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can start doing some light gardening, such as gardening, brisk walking, gentle cycling, after 1 week of surgery. Just be sure to avoid any strenuous activities, like heavy lifting or bending, for a month. Does that sound okay? Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you, that's helpful. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You should continue to use the eye drops as prescribed. If you're running out, your GP should be able to provide some more. You can start using them as directed, four times a day, to help with dryness. Does that make sense? Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, that makes sense. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses. If it's mild and just seems brighter than usual, wearing sunglasses when you're outside should help. But if you're experiencing significant pain when it's bright or if your eye is also red and painful, we may need to assess it further. Does that sound right? Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I understand, thank you. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's common to have blurry vision in the first week after surgery, but it should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry, or getting significantly worse or blurry, we may need to check it to make sure it's okay. Does that sound okay to you? Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That sounds okay. I don't have any more questions. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome! It was my pleasure to help. I'm glad I could answer your questions. Before we go, I just want to check: do you feel like all your questions about your cataract surgery recovery have been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thank you again!

verdict.label: pass
